label: PF Backlog 580
title: Eventing SSOT (Go): transports - inproc callbacks, webhook (HMAC+idempotency), notify/email
body:
## Problem / why
Push transport only exists in the frozen dashboard websocket; external delivery and email are bespoke.

## Goal / value
Pluggable transports behind one interface: inproc (callbacks), webhook (HTTP POST, HMAC signature,
idempotency key), notify/email (reuse notification_system + alerts).

## In scope
- inproc transport (compat with event_bus.on); webhook transport (signing + retry); notify/email adapter.

## Out of scope
- SSE (API surface, E9); alert routing (E6).

## Acceptance criteria
- A subscriber receives via each transport; webhook verifies HMAC; email respects priority gate.

## Verification / test plan
- Webhook HMAC test; inproc callback test; email adapter test.

## Dependencies & links
- E2 (webhook contract), E4 (dispatcher).
